continuity_scope: Diablo IV base game, launch baseline (North American English; 6 June 2023). This is a deliberately bounded franchise pass: it treats Diablo IV as its own game-release continuity witness and excludes Diablo I–III, Diablo Immortal, all post-launch seasons/patches, Vessel of Hatred, Lord of Hatred, and adaptations.
work_or_witnesses: Blizzard: Meet Your Maker on June 6—Pre-Purchase Diablo IV!
Blizzard: Diablo IV Inside the Game: A New Saga
Blizzard: Diablo IV Launches Soon—Here’s What You Need to Know
Blizzard: All Hell Breaks Loose in 2023—Diablo IV is Coming
coverage_rule: All named individual dramatic agents directly identified in the selected official Diablo IV launch-campaign premise and launch-system witnesses: Lilith, Inarius, and Mephisto. The player-created Wanderer and all selectable classes remain terms, not characters. The selected pages do not furnish a reproducible complete cast list for the finished campaign, so unprofiled named quest, town, companion, boss, and lore figures are outside this narrow official-witness cohort.
omissions: Player-created Wanderers and player-selected Barbarian, Druid, Necromancer, Rogue, and Sorceress identities.
Generic demons, angels, humans, cultists, undead, factions, places, items, skills, quests, dungeons, systems, and cosmological regions as character nodes.

Named figures not directly profiled or narratively characterized in the selected launch-premise pages, including campaign figures discoverable only through the finished game, later official recaps, or external databases.

All Diablo I–III and Diablo Immortal material; post-launch seasonal, patch, expansion, and future-retcon material; novels, comics, cinematics outside the selected witness pages, merchandise, and adaptations.
uncertainties: The witnesses are official pre-launch and launch communications rather than a complete in-game quest/codex transcription. This pass is complete only for the three-agent cohort explicitly declared above, not for Diablo IV's entire campaign cast.
Diablo IV is a live-service title. Later seasons, patches, Vessel of Hatred, Lord of Hatred, and future releases can change presentation or add lore but are not folded into this 1.0 baseline.
The sources use North American English terminology. Other localizations, prior-game lore, and later retcons are not silently merged.

The selected premise establishes Lilith and Inarius as co-creators of Sanctuary and Lilith as Mephisto's daughter; it does not by itself resolve the wider franchise's cosmological hierarchy or every version-specific detail.
evidence_basis: First-party Blizzard Diablo IV launch and pre-launch campaign/system pages only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community guide, or unsourced secondary summary is used as evidence.

supports: Diablo IV launch boundary; Lilith and Inarius's return; their co-creation of Sanctuary; launch classes
